why: The counter-rotation `sync` writes goes to the wrong rings: the `shape` marker spins with the hull, so a square turned 45 degrees reads as a diamond, and the shipped solid ring takes a spin it never took before. Issue #1023 rewrote this guard from `ringMarkerFor(identityMarker) !== null` to `identityMarker !== null`, equal only because `shape` is the one style left, and nothing read the written angle off a real view before; the case that does checks both arms.
killedBy: player identity: ring and shell tint holds the `shape` marker still as the hull turns, and leaves the solid ring unturned (issue #1023)
